title: Complexity Caverns exam
summary: The world's mastery exam: analyse loops, recursion and space you haven't seen before. Each section needs 70% on its own.

questions.prompt: What is the time complexity in terms of n?
grid has r rows and c columns. What is the time complexity?
a has n elements. What is the time complexity?
What is the time complexity of g(n)?
What is the auxiliary space of count(n), counting the call stack?
How long does it take to generate (and store) every ordering of n distinct items?
A method copies an array of n ints into a new array, then scans the copy once. What is its auxiliary space?
